def.name: Runner
def.blurb: Fastest on foot, double jump, a sawed-off up close. Fragile.

def.name: Rocketeer
def.blurb: Blast rockets: fire one at your feet to rocket-jump.

def.name: Torch
def.blurb: Flamethrower up close; the oil slicker lays slick, flammable puddles.

def.name: Breacher
def.blurb: Grenade launcher and three proximity mines to lock down a route.

def.name: Bulwark
def.blurb: Huge health, slow, and a spin gun that shreds once it is turning.

def.name: Mechanic
def.blurb: G builds a sentry gun that also heals and restocks teammates beside it.

def.name: Medic
def.blurb: Medi-beam heals teammates; healing charges an overcharge (G): 6 s untouchable for you and your patient.

def.name: Marksman
def.blurb: A charged railgun from long range, an SMG for anyone who gets close.

def.name: Shade
def.blurb: G cloaks you (firing breaks it); a knife in the back kills outright.
